remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature. On backing: In pencil by O'Keeffe: 'Grey Lines with Black Blue and Yellow. 23?" [not verified]. Museum files note Whitney Archive and Abiquiú Notebooks inscription and indicate another: "'Wedding'/by Georgia O'Keeffe 1925" (Alfred Stieglitz, medium not recorded). Lost inscription dates 1925. Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive date 1923. Abiquiú Notebooks dates c. 1923. Pictured in 1934 New York (An American Place) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 56. Reproduced and titled *Grey Line* in *Time* (May 1946). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: In this abstract work, layered pastel forms in shades of pink, light blue, and yellow overlap one another like petals framing the center of a flower. The petal-like shapes are narrow and run vertically along the canvas. A set of larger, softly shaded pink and white shapes frame the central petals.
